Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of
motion. Over six visits, care consisted of physical examination, imaging review, activity modification, a structured home exercise
program, and supervised therapy sessions. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the knee injury. Treatment followed
a typical clinical course, with pain and swelling gradually decreasing and function improving, and visit frequency tapered as the
patient progressed. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider or reported by the patient. Causation of the
current knee injury relative to this collision has not yet been established and remains under review. Billing records containing two
similar charges on the same day are also being verified. Dischrage planning includes continued self-directed exercise and
follow-up as needed.
